answer: Sybil resistance here is a slashable identity bond: each agent locks capital tied to one human attestation, and the reputation graph discounts links between accounts sharing a funding source. A hollow ring of fake agents cannot bridge the trust canyon, because recycled attestations carry no weight and cannot climb toward the zenith of payouts. The attacker funds every new bond and burns fees upfront, then forfeits the whole stake once the loop is found.
